title_ar: الشيخ الددو يزور الشيخ عائض القرني لعيادته
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Visits Sheikh Aidh al-Qarni to Enquire After His Health
body_ar: أدى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو - حفظه الله- اليوم الأربعاء 5 رجب 1437ھ الموافق 13 إبريل 2016م زيارة للشيخ عائض القرني في بيته بمدينة الرياض عاصمة المملكة العربية السعودية، على إثر حادثة إطلاق النار التي تعرض لها في الفلبين، وقد استقبله الشيخ عائض عند باب منزله، حيث بدأ الشيخ الددو تهنئته على سلامته ودعا له بالصحة والعافية وبلغه تحيات أهل موريتانيا ودعائهم له، قبل أن يرحب الشيخ عائض بضيفه الشيخ الددو ويشكره على الزيارة، مقدما شكره لأهل موريتانيا على تضامنهم ودعمهم مشيدا بما عرفوا به من الاهتمام بالعلم وأهله، هذا وقد ختم الشيخ الددو زيارته برقية للشيخ عائض قرأها عليه.
body_en: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew (may God preserve him) paid a visit this Wednesday, 5 Rajab 1437 AH, corresponding to 13 April 2016, to Sheikh Aidh al-Qarni at his home in the city of Riyadh, the capital of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, following the shooting incident to which he had been subjected in the Philippines. Sheikh Aidh received him at the door of his house, where Sheikh al-Dedew began by congratulating him on his safety, praying for his health and well-being, and conveying to him the greetings of the people of Mauritania and their prayers for him; after which Sheikh Aidh welcomed his guest Sheikh al-Dedew and thanked him for the visit, offering his thanks to the people of Mauritania for their solidarity and support, and praising the concern for learning and for the learned by which they are known. Sheikh al-Dedew closed his visit with a healing recitation (ruqyah) for Sheikh Aidh, which he recited over him.

flags.context: the closing clause: هذا وقد ختم الشيخ الددو زيارته برقية للشيخ عائض قرأها عليه
options: with a healing recitation (ruqyah) for Sheikh Aidh, which he recited over him
with a message (barqiyyah) to Sheikh Aidh, which he read out to him
with some lines of verse for Sheikh Aidh, which he read to him
flags.note: Unpointed, بـرقية is either 'بِرُقْيَة' — with a ruqyah, a healing recitation — or 'بَرْقِيَّة', a telegram or message. The context (a sick visit after a shooting) and the verb 'قرأها عليه', recited it OVER him rather than TO him, both favour ruqyah; 'قرأ على' is the standard collocation for performing ruqyah. A written message would normally take 'قرأها له'. The choice changes what is reported to have happened, so it should not be fixed without the site's confirmation.

translator_notes: عيادة in the title is the visiting of a sick person, not a clinic; rendered 'to enquire after his health'.
Sheikh Aidh al-Qarni was wounded in a shooting in Zamboanga, the Philippines, in March 2016. The source gives no further detail and none has been added.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not the date of composition.
